Available for macOS, Windows, Linux, Raspberry Pi, and iOS, it makes it easy to connect computers, mobile devices, and MIDI hardware across your network. Its integrated MIDI Router gives you complete control over how MIDI data is routed between devices. All Bome Network connections are persistent, automatically reconnecting after a restart. Use with the BomeBox Bome Network makes it easy to connect your computer to one or more BomeBoxes over Ethernet or Wi-Fi . Any MIDI application on your computer can send MIDI data to a BomeBox and receive MIDI from it. You can also access MIDI devices connected to the BomeBox directly using Remote Direct MIDI , forwarding selected devices—or all of them—over the network. BMIDI is a cross platform SDK for developers or manufacturers who want to add virtual MIDI ports to their application or driver. It is used by many companies — from very small to very large — for quick and easy virtual port support in their software. The BMIDI Bome Virtual MIDI Port driver works fine with the currently rolled out Windows MIDI Services. They have some known compatibility issues, but as far as we know, not with our drivers. Details Essentially, BMIDI provides a simple library which allows applications to expose one or more MIDI ports to other MIDI applications. Those other applications use the BMIDI ports as if they were external hardware MIDI ports. BMIDI is not a loopback driver: one endpoint is always private, i.e. in your application.
